SELECT 
    fackey,
    support_and_resources->'community_resources' as comm_res,
    support_and_resources->'support_services' as services,
    support_and_resources->'plans'->>'crisis_plan_status' as crisis,
    support_and_resources->'plans'->>'safety_plan_status' as safety,
    (support_and_resources->>'emergency_contact')::int as emergency,
    -- Community resources score
    CASE support_and_resources->'community_resources'
        WHEN '"Limited"' THEN 1
        WHEN '"Adequate"' THEN 2
        WHEN '"Comprehensive"' THEN 3
    END as comm_score,
    -- Support services count (non-None)
    CASE 
        WHEN support_and_resources->'support_services' = '""' OR support_and_resources->'support_services' IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE (length(support_and_resources->>'support_services') - length(replace(support_and_resources->>'support_services', ',', '')) + 1)
             - CASE WHEN support_and_resources->>'support_services' LIKE '%None%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    END as service_count,
    -- Plan scores
    CASE support_and_resources->'plans'->>'crisis_plan_status'
        WHEN 'In Place' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Not Needed' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Needs Update' THEN 0
    END as crisis_score,
    CASE support_and_resources->'plans'->>'safety_plan_status'
        WHEN 'In Place' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Not Needed' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Needs Update' THEN 0
    END as safety_score
FROM facilities LIMIT 5;

-- Step 1: Add the facility_score column if it doesn't exist
ALTER TABLE facilities ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS facility_score INTEGER;

-- Step 2: Update the facility_score based on Resource Adequacy from support_and_resources
UPDATE facilities 
SET facility_score = (
    -- Community resources score: Limited=1, Adequate=2, Comprehensive=3
    CASE support_and_resources->'community_resources'
        WHEN '"Limited"' THEN 1
        WHEN '"Adequate"' THEN 2
        WHEN '"Comprehensive"' THEN 3
        ELSE 0
    END
    +
    -- Support services: count non-"None" services, each worth 1 point
    CASE 
        WHEN support_and_resources->'support_services' IS NULL OR support_and_resources->'support_services' = '""' THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(
            (length(support_and_resources->>'support_services') - length(replace(support_and_resources->>'support_services', ',', '')) + 1)
            - CASE WHEN split_part(support_and_resources->>'support_services', ',', generate_subscripts(string_to_array(support_and_resources->>'support_services', ','), 1)) = 'None' OR 
                        array_position(string_to_array(support_and_resources->>'support_services', ','), 'None') IS NOT NULL 
                   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
            0
        )
    END
    +
    -- Crisis plan status: In Place=2, Not Needed=1, Needs Update=0
    CASE support_and_resources->'plans'->>'crisis_plan_status'
        WHEN 'In Place' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Not Needed' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Needs Update' THEN 0
        ELSE 0
    END
    +
    -- Safety plan status: In Place=2, Not Needed=1, Needs Update=0
    CASE support_and_resources->'plans'->>'safety_plan_status'
        WHEN 'In Place' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Not Needed' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Needs Update' THEN 0
        ELSE 0
    END
);
